meta.name: brand-cog
meta.description: Other tools make logos. CellCog builds brands. #1 on DeepResearch Bench (Feb 2026) for deep strategic reasoning + the widest modality coverage in AI. Brand identity, brand kits, color palettes, typography, brand guidelines, logo design, visual identity, social media, web design, video — all from one brief.

copy.tagline: 从一份简报生成完整的品牌视觉体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从零打造一套专业品牌视觉系统
copy.tagline_en: Generate a complete brand identity from a single brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build a professional brand identity from scratch

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的品牌描述，生成完整的品牌视觉系统，包括 Logo、配色、字体、品牌指南、社交媒体模板、网页素材和视频等。
howto.when: 当你要求创建品牌标识、Logo、配色方案或品牌指南时触发。

say.text: 为我的 SaaS 创业公司创建一个完整的品牌套件。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Logo、配色、字体等全套品牌资产。

say.text: 设计一个名为“NomadNest”的远程工作者共享居住品牌的 Logo。
say.note: Claude 会提供多个 Logo 概念和变体。

say.text: 为我的个人品牌创建一套配色方案和字体推荐。
say.note: Claude 会生成配色板和字体搭配建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a complete brand visual system based on your brand description, including logos, color palettes, typography, brand guidelines, social media templates, web assets, and video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a brand identity, logo, color palette, or brand guidelines.

say_en.text: Create a complete brand kit for my SaaS startup.
say_en.note: Claude will generate logos, colors, fonts, and more.

say_en.text: Design a logo for 'NomadNest', a co-living startup for remote workers.
say_en.note: Claude will provide multiple logo concepts and variations.

say_en.text: Create a color palette and typography system for my personal brand.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a color scheme and font pairings.
